drafts.facet: What happens to a received message until and when it is acknowledged
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B1-T1 defines a single acknowledgement contract: acknowledgement removes a message from that consumer's pending set, and without it the message stays pending and will not be treated as finished for that consumer.
drafts.subject: Consumer acknowledgement

drafts.facet: In what order are one producer's messages delivered to a consumer
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B2-T1 states that messages published by one producer are delivered to a consumer in publish order so replay does not corrupt consumer state.
drafts.subject: Message delivery

drafts.facet: How long it stays alive without renewal
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B3-T1 asks how long a subscription remains alive without renewal and answers that it expires unless renewed within 10 minutes of the previous renewal.
drafts.subject: Subscription

drafts.facet: What happens if it is not delivered within a deadline
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B4-T1 states that a message not delivered within 24 hours of publish is moved to the dead-letter store and is not delivered afterwards.
drafts.subject: Published message

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B1-T1 states that acknowledging a message removes it from that consumer's pending set and that Relay will not deliver it to that consumer again.

value.text: The message is removed from that consumer's pending set and Relay will not deliver it to that consumer again.

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B1-T1 states acknowledgement is required and that an unacknowledged message stays pending for the consumer that received it.

value.text: Until a message is acknowledged it stays pending for the consumer that received it.

drafts.predicate: order of delivery from one producer
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B2-T1 states that messages published by one producer are delivered to a consumer in the order in which they were published.

value.text: Messages published by one producer are delivered to a consumer in the order in which they were published.

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B3-T1 states a subscription expires unless the consumer renews it within 10 minutes of the previous renewal.
EV-LV-B4-T1 states that a message unpublished-to-delivery for 24 hours is moved to the dead-letter store and is not delivered afterwards.

value.text: A message that has not been delivered within 24 hours of being published is moved to the dead-letter store and is not delivered afterwards.

drafts.facet: What happens to a received message until and when it is acknowledged
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B1-T2 answers what acknowledgement does to a received message and that it stays pending until acknowledged, the same locus as ADDR-53ff2ec77ba59cb1.
drafts.subject: Consumer acknowledgement

drafts.facet: In what order are one producer's messages delivered to a consumer
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B2-T2 states that one producer's messages are delivered in publish order and that this order survives redelivery, answering the same order question as ADDR-fae4d2447766ee14.
drafts.subject: Message delivery

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B2-T2 introduces receipts kept for every delivery and discarded after 14 days, a different subject and question from producer-to-consumer delivery order.
drafts.subject: Delivery receipts

drafts.facet: How long it stays alive without renewal
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B3-T2 states the renewal interval after which a subscription lapses, matching ADDR-e2ce413edf45d95f.
drafts.subject: Subscription

drafts.facet: What happens if it is not delivered within a deadline
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B4-T2 describes moving an undelivered published message to the dead-letter store after a deadline, matching ADDR-354966f9aaeb432c.
drafts.subject: Published message

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B1-T2 restates that acknowledgement removes the message from that consumer's pending set and Relay will not deliver it to that consumer again.
EV-LV-B1-T2 restates that until a message is acknowledged it stays pending for the consumer that received it.

drafts.predicate: effect of acknowledgement on storage slot
drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B1-T2 adds a compatible acknowledgement effect: the reserved storage slot is released for reuse by later messages.

value.text: Acknowledging releases the storage slot reserved for the message while it was pending, so the slot can be reused by later messages.

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B2-T2 restates that messages published by one producer are delivered to a consumer in the order in which they were published.
EV-LV-B2-T2 adds that publication order survives redelivery, a compatible ordering proposition at this locus.

value.text: When a message from a producer is redelivered, it is delivered before any message that the same producer published after it.

drafts.rationale: EV-LV-B2-T2 states that delivery receipts are kept for 14 days and are then discarded.
EV-LV-B3-T2 requires renewal at least every 600 seconds from the previous renewal, which is the same 10-minute lifetime without renewal.
EV-LV-B4-T2 states that an undelivered message is dead-lettered after 48 hours of being published and is not delivered afterwards.

value.text: A message that has not been delivered within 48 hours of being published is moved to the dead-letter store and is not delivered afterwards.

drafts.reason: EV-LV-B4-T2 replaces the 24-hour undelivered deadline with 48 hours, so the prior fate claim is no longer current.
